name: hands-on-react
description: 动手学 React：中文交互式 React 课程，50 课 6 阶段，基于 Rspress 2（MDX + React），可运行示例、预测题、自动判分练习、间隔复习和阶段测验

scripts.predev: node scripts/gen-registry.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build-react19.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build-libs.mjs
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/gen-registry.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build-react19.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build-libs.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:content && npm run test:unit
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
